SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."GLAccount","d"."CompanyCode","d"."AuthorizationGroup","d"."AccountingClerk","d"."LastInterestCalcRunDate","d"."CreationDate","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."LastChangeDateTime","d"."PlanningLevel","d"."HouseBank","d"."HouseBankAccount","d"."ExchRateDifferencesAccountDetn","d"."ReconciliationAccountType","d"."TaxCategory","d"."InterestCalculationCode","d"."GLAccountCurrency","d"."ReconciliationAcctIsChangeable","d"."IsManagedExternally","d"."IsAutomaticallyPosted","d"."LineItemDisplayIsEnabled","d"."SupplementIsAllowed","d"."IsOpenItemManaged","d"."InterestCalculationDate","d"."IntrstCalcFrequencyInMonths","d"."AcctgDocItmDisplaySequenceRule","d"."AlternativeGLAccount","d"."JointVentureRecoveryCode","d"."CommitmentItem","d"."CommitmentItemShortID","d"."TaxCodeIsRequired","d"."BalanceHasLocalCurrency","d"."ValuationGroup","d"."APARToleranceGroup","d"."AccountIsBlockedForPosting","d"."AccountIsMarkedForDeletion","d"."ClearingIsLedgerGroupSpecific","d"."CashPlanningGroup","d"."IsCashFlowAccount","d"."GLAcctInflationKey","d"."FieldStatusGroup","d"."MultiCurrencyAccountingCode","d"."IsExtendedOpenItemManaged","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_GLACCOUNTINCOMPANYCODE_S4_CURR_Delta" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'I_GLACCOUNTINCOMPANYCODE'
